description:
User-requested follow-up to zaq-r4n. Implementation authorized by the user; progress and validation recorded in comments.

Problem
WhatsApp Disable now logs out the selected profile. Enable restarts its runtime but does not automatically open the existing-profile QR/status modal. The user should be guided to scan a fresh QR when relinking is required.

Scope and acceptance
- Add an adapter-specific enable policy/function, with normal behavior as the default; keep ChannelConnectorCard provider-agnostic.
- After successfully enabling WhatsApp, automatically open the existing selected configuration's linked-device connection modal.
- Reuse the saved configuration ID, binding and profile. Do not create a new connector or invoke provisional new-profile onboarding.
- Display connecting, QR challenge, expired/retry, connected and error states using existing library/UI lifecycle support. Do not force QR pairing if a valid saved session connects directly.
- Retrying targets the same profile. Closing the modal follows existing saved-profile semantics and does not delete configuration or cancel another profile.
- Keep other adapters' Enable behavior unchanged. Preserve the WhatsApp Disable confirmation/logout behavior from zaq-r4n.
- Report enable/start failures accurately; do not present a QR or connected state for the wrong configuration.

Action reuse assessment (verified during implementation; see comments)
Evidence: ChannelsLive.toggle_active_config starts the enabled configuration runtime; LinkedDeviceUI.open opens status for an existing configuration; channel_ingress_status and channel_retry_linked_device support saved-profile status/retry. jido_chat_whatsapp ConnectionWorker handles QR connection updates and emits qr_available for ordinary saved-profile workers.
Decision: reuse existing enable/runtime, status/retry operations and existing linked-device modal. Adapter-specific post-enable presentation is local-only UI policy; it is not an independent domain Action. Do not add a second login implementation or expose agent tools.
Contract: authenticated actor plus selected persisted configuration; apply adapter policy after successful enable, preserve profile isolation, surface failures, avoid duplicate startup on repeated clicks. BO cross-service calls continue through NodeRouter.dispatch/1 with Zaq.Event; CommunicationBridge/JidoChatBridge and the package own runtime/QR lifecycle.
Before coding, inspect current Action/domain API ownership and authorization. If discovery shows a missing essential operation, create its prerequisite Action issue before consumer implementation.

Validation and gates
- Focused policy/LiveView tests: WhatsApp enable opens the selected existing profile; other adapters remain unchanged; no duplicate config; connected session; QR expiry/retry; startup failure; repeated clicks; multi-profile isolation.
- Obtain explicit approval before changing existing test behavior; previous approval covered the Disable confirmation scenario only.
- Run mix q and isolated tests; final mix precommit per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md.
- Reuse zaq-0l7.7 human UX approval and zaq-0l7.8 consolidated E2E. Add enable-after-logout QR relinking to their review/scenarios; new feature E2E authoring waits for explicit UX approval.

Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/channels.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md and docs/testing-approach.md before affected work.
